status: Reviewed source evidence only; no generated design approved
review_method: Viewed all 10 source groups as complete four-phase boards and nearest-neighbor 6x enlargements. Also viewed key NPC three-slot/four-phase family boards, lower-detail boards and pixel-coordinate grids.
coordinates: Raw original decoded pixel coordinates; xyxy boxes have exclusive right/bottom. All feature boxes are review regions, not masks or exact anatomical contact points.
global_limits: Do not infer appearance or age from NPC names.
Do not invent hidden hands/feet, weapons, equipment or idle motion.
Checker shadow is baked into the source and remains unsegmented.
Native cell root is not an anatomical ground contact.
Keep original names, separate placement records and story functions unchanged.
